what: Outside sets whose results have been seen. Under docs/JUDGE_LOOP.md's rule, a set whose results were seen is development data from then on: it may be used to develop, to monitor for regressions, or to reproduce a published run, and never again as a test. tools/outside_eval.py reads this file. Its loader refuses a spent set unless the caller states one of those purposes, and its converter writes a _spent header line into every spent set it produces, so an ad-hoc script that reads the file directly meets the rule on its first line (A357, 2026-10-16).
